question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

During my initial days at Kodai, I was fascinated ________ the landscape, and I focused _____ landscape photography.
solution:
The correct answer is '**by; on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**by**" is used to indicate the agent performing the action (fascinated by the landscape).
 
• The preposition "**on**" is used to show the focus or area of interest (focused on landscape photography).
 
• **Option 3** is the only one that correctly uses both prepositions in context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"During my initial days at Kodai, I was fascinated **by**__ the landscape, and I focused __**on**__ landscape photography."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "at; in"** is incorrect because "at" is not used to indicate fascination and "in" is not appropriate for focus in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "on; on"** is incorrect because "on" does not convey the correct relationship for fascination.
 
• **Option 4: "on; in"** is incorrect because "on" is not the correct preposition for fascination and "in" is not appropriate for focus in this context.
